facts.value: Gain the practical and research skills necessary to support individual and community well-being with a Master of Arts in sociology from Arizona State University online. In this program, you’ll learn how patterns of social relationships and interactions impact individuals, family members and employees. As a graduate, you’ll be prepared to make a positive impact in public, private and nonprofit sector organizations.
